messages.subject: International Executive Profile | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Accel HR Consultants Team,

I am writing to introduce my profile for senior international and GCC-facing mandates where government relations, ESG, external affairs, social performance and country-level stakeholder leadership are central to business delivery.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, social performance, compliance coordination, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery across a major mining operation.

Across more than 12 years in multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, I have worked at the interface of executive management, public institutions, regulators, communities and operating teams. My current exposure also includes renewable-energy stakeholder coordination and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and selected VP-track assignments in ESG and Sustainability, Corporate and External Affairs, Government Relations, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and country-facing leadership. I am internationally mobile, open to the Middle East and wider global markets, and available following a 30-day notice period. Employer-supported work authorization is required where applicable.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration. I would welcome a discussion regarding relevant current or upcoming mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc. (Zijin Mining Group)
Georgetown, Guyana
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/
